scenario_description: A school district must serve 800 lunches each day across separate school sites. Each option serves a different group of students, so meal capacities add in this simplified classroom model. All options are assumed to meet nutrition and food-safety requirements; those standards are outside this numeric simulation. Costs, operating emissions, land, and capacity limits are illustrative.
mission: Design a meal-service package for at least 800 meals/day within a $2 million setup budget. Respect each option's capacity limit and keep modeled annual operating CO2 at or below 45 tons. Explain the cost and access tradeoffs.

comprehension_questions.prompt: How many lunches must be served each day?
Which condition is assumed for every meal-service option?
options: Nutrition and food-safety requirements are met

reflection_questions: How does your final package serve the separate school sites?
Which cost, access, and operating-emissions tradeoff mattered most?
How would you revise the plan if demand rose?

event.label: A new school wing opens
event.description: The new wing increases lunch demand by 10%.
